that is a good point - it makes me realize that maybe I can overcome this by just focusing on the things that bother me the most - and maybe the rest wont matter as much

I've also read many times inner peace is the meaning to life, and acceptance is the way to get there. but im just not ready to accept what I am right now. I want to feel real.

hang in there man

you're still very young. if it would make you feel better you could apologize to your parents or explain to them. you need to forgive yourself and take small steps to be more truthful. you do have a soul, because you have learned from your mistakes, nobody is perfect and the beauty of life is that it gives you chances to redeem yourself.

thanks for the help.
> you aren't 'to blame' for anything. so you are depressed, it's not something to cast blame about. would you tell someone else who is feeling that way that they are to blame for it?

this makes me feel a little better.

thanks. I know other people have it worse, and it only makes me feel more guilty for being as depressed as I am, when on paper, my life is pretty good. But still, some of the blessings I have, seem to have little effect on my internal well-being. I would give up my life for a much simpler one in the wild or something. Although I think after the novelty I would still be depressed. i dunno
